doc.title: Dan Morgenstern — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The Just Jazz series guests
summary: Dexter Gordon, Don Byas, Hackett and Dickenson, and Erroll Garner on the Chicago series.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: We did do a series. The series came out pretty well. Dexter Gordon was visiting. So we did him. Don Byas was visiting. So we managed to do him. We did Bobby Hackett and Vic Dickenson with Don DeMicheal on drums. I got Don on the show. We did Erroll Garner, which was difficult because of – I like Martha Glaser very much, but she is a demanding person. But she wasn’t there. Erroll was a dream to work with. A wonderful show. How did I get into this? Because I was saying something about television.
